integrity_notes: Missing player, bench, appearance and xG/xGA fields are not imputed.
Only structured player details from the reviewed source batches are normalized; this is not full-season player coverage.
Substitution table includes only events with both incoming and outgoing player names; red cards are not misclassified as substitutions.
XG values retain their source URL and status; conflicting or unaccepted candidate pairs are not silently selected.
All match-level xGA values remain blank because no explicit free match-level xGA field passed independent source verification.
Displayed substitution time strings were restored from the official match-page extraction where minute_display was available; no minute values were estimated.
2026-11-03 incremental player extraction added 3 official match cards (IDs 34597–34599), 120 player rows and 30 substitution events; full-season player coverage remains incomplete.
Independent xGA source audit reviewed FootyStats, TACTIX, JPick/Sportmonks and official J.League pages; no free public source with explicit match-level xGA passed verification, so xGA remains blank.
branch_alignment_note: The canonical results CSV is 130 rows on both main and audit/stable-match-id-mapping-20261101; ISO dates and unique date/home/away keys verified.

player_detail_increment.source: J.League Data Site official match cards
player_detail_increment.score_and_lineup_crosscheck: Official match-card pages checked; starting XIs, benches, and substitution timelines transcribed
player_detail_increment.caveat: Not full-season coverage; no xG/xGA added from these official pages.

xga_source_audit_summary.note: FootyStats public page exposes recent match xG pairs and aggregate xGA, not a verified explicit match-level xGA field. TACTIX page exposes team-level xPts summary sourced from apisports_proxy, not raw match-level xGA. Sportmonks explicitly documents fixture-level xGA but its xG add-on is paid. Official J.League match cards do not publish xG/xGA.
